name: Super Hyperion
description: As part of the Superking Layer System, its Super Ring features angled contact points designed to improve its offensive capabilities and Smash Attack. Its design is optimized for aggressive competitive gameplay.

ability.name: Angled Smash Ring
ability.description: The Super Ring's angled contact points improve Smash Attack output, granting a passive boost to attack power during aggressive exchanges.

special_move.name: Super Strike
special_move.description: Super Hyperion channels the Superking system's angled contact points into a single devastating smash, crushing through the opponent's defenses.
flavour_texts: ⚔️ **Super Strike** — Super Hyperion unleashes the Superking smash!
